title: Content Brief Builder
one_line: Write a content brief a writer can execute without inventing the substance, including where the non generic part comes from.
description: Write a content brief a writer can execute without inventing the substance, including where the non generic part comes from. Use when briefing a writer, planning an article, or when published content keeps reading like everything else.
paragraph: Content reads generic when the brief specified the topic and the structure but not the substance, so the writer fills the gap with what everyone already knows. This skill requires a source for the one section that makes the piece unrepeatable, and refuses to brief a piece where that section does not exist.
